title: Edit a manual subscription
caption: Manual rows only (billing_provider = manual); Stripe-billed rows show a note and Resync from Stripe instead.

steps.title: Find it
steps.body: Filter by provider, status or plan; open the row.
steps.expect: Detail with plan, status, trial end, periods, invoices and Stripe events (empty before M5).

steps.title: Change plan, trial end or status
steps.body: **Edit the manual subscription**: plan (active plans), trial end (a UTC day; the time of day is kept), status Trial / Active / Canceled → **Save changes…** → reason in the dialog that lists the changes.
steps.expect: Only changed fields sent with If-Match; outcome shows the saved values; audit `subscription.manually_updated`.

steps.title: Check the effects
steps.body: Open the OTA page and the portal; with `FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING` on, wait for the daily `billing.manual_trials` (08:10 UTC).
steps.expect: Active: go-live allowed, no trial banner. A later trial end on a past_due row reopens it as trialing. Retired plan → '422 plan_not_active' at the plan; another current row → '409 current_exists' at the status.
